title: Why it has that role
campeon_mercado: The hardest reference to beat: the market baseline, without its margin, with the lowest log loss.
variante_mercado: A variant of the market baseline.
mejor_que_mercado: Beats the market reference with enough evidence.
rechazado_peor_que_mercado: Worse than the reference and adds nothing to it: rejected.
evidencia_insuficiente: The evidence cannot yet tell it apart from the reference.
sin_partidos_comunes: It shares no match with the reference, so it cannot be compared.
muestra_insuficiente: Too few matches with a forecast and a closing price to judge it.
